author: Stahly
description:
Can't figure out how to take sharp and well-lit pictures of your models for Instagram? Your desk lamp or DIY solutions just won't cut it? Don't worry. All you need for taking great pictures of your models is a sheet of white paper, your phone or camera, and cheap LED photo lights for about 40 £/€/$. Find out more in this post.

The post Mastering miniature photography #1: better light setup on a budget appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Mastering miniature photography #1: better light setup on a budget
